scenario_description:
Objective: Add a free personalized warmup card to an already planned Route Ready gym session.
Emerging Need: A possible laminating table is initially uncertain, then becomes usable only when staff confirms the eligible focus choices, required fields, and short intake window.
Decision Context: The session focus comes from partner coordination, while stored training notes and the member profile distinguish the right cue set and identifier from generic requests.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a handy gym-bag reference; ignoring it simply leaves the session unchanged once the print queue locks.
Scope: The card is an optional personal reference only. It does not renew Julian’s expired lead-belay wristband or establish permission to lead climb or belay; those permissions must be checked separately.

parameter.title: Route Ready Friday gym session
parameter.description: Casual indoor climbing session with Nora after work.

parameter.subject: Possible warmup-card table for Friday sessions
parameter.body: We may have the laminator back for tomorrow evening and might print a few no-cost member warmup cards during Friday sessions. Please do not send requests yet; staff still needs to confirm the allowed focus choices, intake address, and cutoff.

parameter.content: Still good for Route Ready tomorrow. If our current gym permissions allow it, I would prefer easy lead-mileage laps; otherwise we can choose an allowed easy session. A personal lead-mileage warmup card would still be useful as a reference, but it would not renew anyone’s wristband.

parameter.subject: Warmup-card intake open until 5:20 today
parameter.body: The laminator is working. We can print 12 free member warmup cards for pickup at tomorrow's Friday sessions. Reply to warmupdesk@routeready.example by 5:20 PM today with your Route Ready member ID, one focus choice from lead mileage, bouldering, or mobility, a short card title, and exactly four cue lines. One card per member.

parameter.subject: Warmup-card queue locked
parameter.body: The 5:20 PM warmup-card intake has closed and the laminated batch has gone to print. Staff cannot add late requests for tomorrow's pickup table.
